messages:
isabel: quick heads-up — PR #487 (function-calling + structured output) landed but there are three small followups: link fixes in examples, one ambiguous JSON schema example, and the python SDK snippet path is outdated.
noah: pinging in case you saw the failing linkcheck from CI this morning — broken anchor on 'structured-output#envelopes'\.
evie: saw it, will patch the anchor. also the example for 'action' enum is currently missing required property in the schema, which trips the parser in some runtimes.
tj: can you paste the schema? i can add a tiny unit test in docs-ci to catch this.
isabel: here — note the current docs show an open-ended shape, but we recommend a strict enum for output actions:
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "required": ["action"],
  "properties": {
    "action": {"type": "string", "enum": ["create", "update", "delete"]},
    "payload": {"type": ["object", "null"]}
  },
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```
andre: thanks — that fixes the parser flakiness we saw in private integrations. i'll add a small note about fallback behavior when `payload` is null (mentioning the SDK returns None).
docs-bot: CI: linkchecker failed in /docs/tooling/structured-output.md: anchor 'envelopes' not found (see https://ci.internal/links/487).
evie: i'll update the anchor and also update `sdk/examples/call.py` -> `sdk/examples/tool_call.py` path in the snippet (was renamed last month).
noah: for the SDK snippet, can we add both a sync and async example? ours currently only shows sync. tiny two-line async example would help.
tj: i'll add the async snippet and wire a docs-ci test that loads the example and validates the JSON output shape against the schema above.
isabel: perfect. can we also add a short note under 'guardrails' about preferring enums + required fields for action-like outputs so devs don't rely on loose parsing? just one sentence.
andre: done — will open a tiny PR to the docs branch with the schema fix + guardrail sentence + link patch. tagging @isabel for review.
isabel: thanks! if we can get the PR merged before EOD the integration team can re-run their smoke tests tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
noah: also updated the cross-link in the migration guide to point to the new snippet path. will post the PR URL in this thread when ready.
docs-bot: PR opened by andre: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/493 (includes schema fix, snippet path, guardrail sentence).
isabel: will review in a bit. if anyone needs to block on me for wording, DM me; otherwise looks straightforward.
noah: cool, thanks everyone. keeping this thread for the final PR link + CI green status.
